summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for phase 59 (fuse-ipns-verify-publish-hardening-and-cleanup) to produce a structured PLAN.md via the research → plan → verify pipeline.
summary.outcome: Research (59-RESEARCH.md), validation (59-VALIDATION.md), and pattern mapping (59-PATTERNS.md) completed successfully; the planner subagent was spawned but the transcript ends before its result is returned.

repo: Phase 59 targets durability-critical FUSE Rust files with six concrete todo writeups in .planning/todos/pending/ — no CONTEXT.md was needed because the todos serve as the spec.

TEE republish path bypasses the embedded-sequence gate in verify.rs entirely — the re-sign risk (Finding F) is not present, but unifying FUSE to embed=1 is still recommended to allow removal of the verify.rs hotfix.
auto_chain_active flag in phase frontmatter must be cleared when the workflow is invoked manually (without --auto/--chain) to prevent unintended auto-advance.
The TS API surface extractor produces empty output for pure Rust phases — this is expected and the artifact should be omitted from planner hints rather than treated as an error.
Pattern mapper produced 9/9 analogs (59-PATTERNS.md), indicating strong prior-art coverage for this phase's scope.
workflow: The commit_failed signal after git commits is a known false-negative in this repo's GSD tooling — actual commit success should be verified separately.
Todo-archival (moving completed todos from .planning/todos/pending/ to .planning/todos/completed/) should be included as an explicit task in the generated PLAN.md when todos are the phase spec.
Research-only mode (--research-phase N) exists as a cheaper iteration loop when replanning is not needed — useful for correction-without-replanning cycles.
VALIDATION.md is committed before the planner runs, so the planner can reference the validated test infrastructure strategy.

friction: commit_failed false-negative requires a secondary verification step after every git commit, adding noise to the workflow.
Transcript ends mid-planner-run — planner result and verification loop outcome are unknown.
open_items: Planner subagent result not captured — 59-PLAN.md may or may not have been written; verification loop (gsd-plan-checker) has not run.
verify.rs hotfix removal is deferred pending the embed=1 unification work identified in research Finding F.
Six todo writeups in .planning/todos/pending/ need to be archived to .planning/todos/completed/ once the plan is executed.
